# Route I `AnchorE2Data`: the E2 anchor-moment bounds `L0`, `L1` (t4b, 7 Nov 2026)

Generated by `work/tools/g3/t4b/e2gen.py` + `mkdata.py` (do not edit by hand).  For the two frozen K = 128
signed families `(da^i, dv^i)` (`UnsignedInstance.da0_128 ...`) and the anchor-0 cells of `CapSourceData`:
`L_i = 2 <rowT R, da^i> + <anchorV R C, dv^i> <= L_i^+`, with `L_0^+ = -387206336/10^13` and
`L_1^+ = -493372324/10^10` (the literals of `T4Instance.hI_of_moves`).  Data: the two integer
polynomials `zRof`, `zCof` (kernel-checked against their definitions), 704 dyadic pairs `(n1, n2)` per
family (128-bit numerators of the endpoints of `vY`), `Lc = lcm(1..140)`.

-- kcost: 141 divisibility tests of a 60-digit integer, below 1 s

  · omega

def Tl : List (List ℤ) := (List.range 131).map fun n => (Tflat.drop (n * (n + 1) / 2)).take (n + 1)

-- kcost: 129 recursion steps on integer lists of at most 131 entries; below 5 s
theorem Tl_step_aux : (List.range 129).all (fun n =>
    decide (T4Instance.chebStep (Tl.getD n []) (Tl.getD (n + 1) []) = Tl.getD (n + 2) [])) = true := by
  decide +kernel

theorem Tl_step : ∀ n < 129, T4Instance.chebStep (Tl.getD n []) (Tl.getD (n + 1) []) = Tl.getD (n + 2) [] := by
  intro n hn
  have := List.all_eq_true.mp Tl_step_aux n (List.mem_range.mpr hn)
  exact of_decide_eq_true this

theorem Tl_01 : Tl.getD 0 [] = [1] ∧ Tl.getD 1 [] = [0, 1] := by decide +kernel

def foldT : List ℤ → ℕ → List ℤ
  | [], _ => []
  | c :: cs, n => T4Instance.addL (T4Instance.smulL c (Tl.getD n [])) (foldT cs (n + 1))

theorem chebSum_Tl : ∀ (cs : List ℤ) (n : ℕ), n + cs.length ≤ 129 →
    T4Instance.chebSum cs (Tl.getD n []) (Tl.getD (n + 1) []) = foldT cs n := by
  intro cs
  induction cs with
  | nil => intro n _; rfl
  | cons c cs ih =>
    intro n hn
    simp only [T4Instance.chebSum, foldT]
    rw [Tl_step n (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hn; omega)]
    have := ih (n + 1) (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hn; omega)
    rw [this]

theorem chebPoly_eq (ws : List ℤ) (h : ws.length + 1 ≤ 129) :
    UnsignedInstance.chebPoly 0 ws = foldT (0 :: ws) 0 := by
  unfold UnsignedInstance.chebPoly
  obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := Tl_01
  rw [← chebSum_Tl (0 :: ws) 0 (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega), h0, h1]

def dat0 : List (ℕ × ℕ) := (datA0.zip datB0).map fun p => (p.1.toNat, p.2.toNat)

-- kcost: Chebyshev recursion of 129 steps on integers of at most 560 bits, compared with the literal; below 5 s
theorem zR0_eq : zRof Lc da0_128 dv0_128 = zR0 := by
  unfold zRof
  rw [chebPoly_eq _ (by rw [UnsignedInstance.weightsOf_length, len_da0_128]; norm_num)]
  decide +kernel
theorem zC0_eq : zCof Lc dv0_128 = zC0 := by
  unfold zCof
  rw [chebPoly_eq _ (by rw [UnsignedInstance.weightsOf_length, len_dv0_128]; norm_num)]
  decide +kernel

-- kcost: 704 row cells, per cell two integer Horner evaluations of degree 129 at 128-bit points, two
-- rational divisions, 2 x 40 rational series terms; est. 60 to 200 s (measured value in the build log)
theorem row_ok0 : rowOK zR0 128 row0 dat0 = true := by decide +kernel

-- kcost: the same cells, rational sum and the column sum (628 cells, one Horner each); est. 60 to 200 s
theorem final_q0 :
    (rowSum zR0 Lc (BRof Lc da0_128 dv0_128) 128 40 (sumP row0) row0 dat0 -
      2 * colSum zC0 Lc (sumP col0) col0) / (((2 ^ 40 : ℕ) : ℚ) * (Lc : ℚ)) ≤ -6050099 / 156250000000 := by
  decide +kernel

theorem L0_le :
    2 * CompletedGas.barrierInner (CompletedGas.rowT (refRowF 0)) (trialSeqOf da0_128 (2 ^ 40)) +
      CompletedGas.barrierInner (CompletedGas.anchorV (refRowF 0) (refColF 0))
        (trialSeqOf dv0_128 (2 ^ 40)) ≤ (-6050099 : ℝ) / 156250000000 := by
  have h := E2_bound (la := da0_128) (lv := dv0_128) (D := 2 ^ 40) (Lc := Lc) (by positivity)
    Lc_pos (by rw [len_da0_128, len_dv0_128]) Lc_div
    (by rw [zR0_eq]; decide) (by rw [zC0_eq]; decide) (by rw [len_da0_128]; norm_num)
    (k := 128) (N := 40) (dat := dat0) (by rw [zR0_eq]; exact row_ok0)
    (by rw [zR0_eq]; decide) (by rw [zC0_eq]; decide)
  refine h.trans ?_
  rw [zR0_eq, zC0_eq]
  have hq := final_q0
  have hc := (Rat.cast_le (K := ℝ)).mpr hq
  push_cast at hc
  have e : ((2 : ℝ) ^ 40) * (Lc : ℝ) = ((2 ^ 40 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (Lc : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
  rw [e]
  convert hc using 1
  norm_num

#print axioms CatalanMeasure.GenD.Signed.RouteI.AnchorE2Data.L0_le

32326824857488175392076442147356678597, 31759687579287732317830341563312336149, 31542407310810700977987151968684464712]
def dat1 : List (ℕ × ℕ) := (datA1.zip datB1).map fun p => (p.1.toNat, p.2.toNat)

-- kcost: Chebyshev recursion of 129 steps on integers of at most 560 bits, compared with the literal; below 5 s
theorem zR1_eq : zRof Lc da1_128 dv1_128 = zR1 := by
  unfold zRof
  rw [chebPoly_eq _ (by rw [UnsignedInstance.weightsOf_length, len_da1_128]; norm_num)]
  decide +kernel
theorem zC1_eq : zCof Lc dv1_128 = zC1 := by
  unfold zCof
  rw [chebPoly_eq _ (by rw [UnsignedInstance.weightsOf_length, len_dv1_128]; norm_num)]
  decide +kernel

-- kcost: 704 row cells, per cell two integer Horner evaluations of degree 129 at 128-bit points, two
-- rational divisions, 2 x 40 rational series terms; est. 60 to 200 s (measured value in the build log)
theorem row_ok1 : rowOK zR1 128 row0 dat1 = true := by decide +kernel

-- kcost: the same cells, rational sum and the column sum (628 cells, one Horner each); est. 60 to 200 s
theorem final_q1 :
    (rowSum zR1 Lc (BRof Lc da1_128 dv1_128) 128 40 (sumP row0) row0 dat1 -
      2 * colSum zC1 Lc (sumP col0) col0) / (((2 ^ 40 : ℕ) : ℚ) * (Lc : ℚ)) ≤ -123343081 / 2500000000 := by
  decide +kernel

theorem L1_le :
    2 * CompletedGas.barrierInner (CompletedGas.rowT (refRowF 0)) (trialSeqOf da1_128 (2 ^ 40)) +
      CompletedGas.barrierInner (CompletedGas.anchorV (refRowF 0) (refColF 0))
        (trialSeqOf dv1_128 (2 ^ 40)) ≤ (-123343081 : ℝ) / 2500000000 := by
  have h := E2_bound (la := da1_128) (lv := dv1_128) (D := 2 ^ 40) (Lc := Lc) (by positivity)
    Lc_pos (by rw [len_da1_128, len_dv1_128]) Lc_div
    (by rw [zR1_eq]; decide) (by rw [zC1_eq]; decide) (by rw [len_da1_128]; norm_num)
    (k := 128) (N := 40) (dat := dat1) (by rw [zR1_eq]; exact row_ok1)
    (by rw [zR1_eq]; decide) (by rw [zC1_eq]; decide)
  refine h.trans ?_
  rw [zR1_eq, zC1_eq]
  have hq := final_q1
  have hc := (Rat.cast_le (K := ℝ)).mpr hq
  push_cast at hc
  have e : ((2 : ℝ) ^ 40) * (Lc : ℝ) = ((2 ^ 40 : ℕ) : ℝ) * (Lc : ℝ) := by push_cast; ring
  rw [e]
  convert hc using 1
  norm_num

#print axioms CatalanMeasure.GenD.Signed.RouteI.AnchorE2Data.L1_le

end
end CatalanMeasure.GenD.Signed.RouteI.AnchorE2Data
